thread:
lei (encops): heads up — ran a staging restore and hit sporadic decrypt failures on snapshot parts. looks like not a missing grant. error is AEAD auth fail on specific multipart ranges :/
omar (sre): can you paste the exact log lines? is this during rewrap or restore path?
jessica (sec-eng): AEAD auth fail usually means tag/iv mismatch. did the rewrap job touch multipart objects?
lei (encops): log: `restore: part_index=4 decrypt failed: aead: authentication failed (tag mismatch)`. We rewrapped keys last night via kms-rewrap-job v2. The job reports success for the object, but parts 2/4/7 fail when assembled.
marc (storage): interesting — our uploader splits snapshots into parts and stores metadata per-part (iv, aad). If the rewrap job re-associated metadata at object-level rather than part-level, parts could be using stale IVs.
ayan (platform): @marc do we have a rewrap path that does object-level envelope re-encryption instead of per-part? I thought we rewrap each part individually.
marc (storage): it should be per-part. but the rewrap job was recently parallelized (PR #4821) — I can see a race where part metadata update can get overwritten by a finalize step that writes consolidated metadata.
omar (sre): is this reproducible? can we run a small restore and log metadata per part before/after rewrap?
lei (encops): yes repro: ran `restore --snapshot=staging-20260301 --parts` and compare `metadata.iv` for part 4 before rewrap vs after. before: `iv=0x9a3f...`, after: `iv=0xdead...` but ciphertext for part stayed same.
jessica (sec-eng): that explains AEAD auth fail — ciphertext+wrong iv => auth tag fails. This is not a KMS grant issue, it's metadata inconsistency introduced during rewrap consolidation.
ci-kms-bot: kms-rewrap-job v2 completed: snapshot-id=staging-20260301 parts=12 duration=34m status=success.
ayan (platform): timeline: rewrap-job parallelized (Mar 2), object finalize consolidation added (Mar 10), first failure observed (Mar 11). Rollback candidate: revert PR #4821 or force rewrap via safe per-part transactional update.
marc (storage): temporary mitigation: disable rewrap-job for staging and prod, and run a fix that locks per-part metadata updates. I'll open a patch.
lei (encops): can we mark affected snapshots as "do not auto-restore" and prepare a manual-decrypt path with original IVs if we have them in old audit logs?
jessica (sec-eng): check audit logs: we should have per-part metadata pre-rewrap in backup-audit-service for at least 30d. If present we can reassign correct IVs and rewrap again. Also notify SRE/CS if any customers attempted restore.
omar (sre): I'll coordinate a small canary: pick a single staging snapshot, re-run rewrap with per-part locking and attempt restore. If good, we can run a corrected pass for the batch.
marc (storage): patch inbound: `storage/rewrap: add per-part txn and finalize only after all parts updated`. will cut a hotfix branch and test.
ayan (platform): owners: marc (storage) hotfix, omar (sre) canary + rollback plan, jessica (sec-eng) compliance note, lei (encops) triage + audit lookup. ETA for canary: 60-90m.
lei (encops): thanks. quick note: add a guard to rewrap-job to verify per-part metadata hash against a pre-wrap snapshot. If mismatch, fail loudly instead of writing success.
jessica (sec-eng): agree — also add a post-rewrap verification step: attempt an AEAD self-check on a random part using new envelope before marking success.
marc (storage): ack. I'll run the fix and ping when canary started.
ayan (platform): I'll disable scheduled rewrap runs and keep a short incident ticket for follow-up, linking this thread.
lei (encops): filing incident ticket now and attaching logs. thanks all :thumbsup:
